title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to conduct a phishing attack…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 contain an open redirect vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to conduct a phishing attack. The vulnerability requires authentication and user interaction to exploit. The CVSS score is low, indicating limited impact primarily on confidentiality.
